Name: NPC Slap Carry Pick Up and Slap Anyone
Author: ttxxxxx1
Description:
Have you ever walked past an NPC in Stardew Valley and thought, “I really want to pick this person up”?
[b]NPC Slap Carry[/b] is a comedy-focused SMAPI mod that lets you grab nearby characters, hold them by the collar, and repeatedly slap them. The target stays close to the player instead of being thrown wildly across the screen, creating a fast and satisfying slap animation inspired by slap-style novelty mods.
The mod supports regular villagers, children, special characters, farm animals, pets, horses, monsters, and other multiplayer farmers. Nearly every target type can be enabled or disabled individually.
Walk close to a target and press [b]G[/b] to pick them up. While carrying them, use [b]J[/b] or the left mouse button to slap from one side, and [b]K[/b] or the right mouse button to slap from the other side. Press [b]G[/b] or [b]Escape[/b] to safely put the target down.
Slapping has no built-in speed limit when unlimited slapping is enabled, so every click or key press immediately performs another slap. The animation uses a restrained collar-hold pose with small impact movement instead of large side-to-side displacement.
Impact effects include pixel stars, speed lines, hit flashes, floating text, screen shake, sound effects, and alternating-combo reactions. The strength of these effects can be adjusted through the configuration menu.
The mod also supports multiplayer. Players can pick up and slap other farmers, and the carried player can optionally break free. For the best multiplayer experience, every player should install the same version of the mod.
Targets can be configured to escape after a certain number of slaps. Friendship loss, stamina cost, visual effects, target categories, controls, multiplayer synchronization, escape behavior, and slap intensity can all be changed through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] or the generated
[code]config.json[/code]file.
By default, the mod is configured as a harmless comedy mod: friendship loss and stamina cost are disabled, and targets are safely restored when dropped, when the location changes, when the game saves, or when a player disconnects.
